title: Space Atlas — Student Reference
description: An interactive space-science reference for grades 4-8. Explore 3D planetary models, verify scale vs. distance, and trace evidence to NASA, JPL, and ESA.
ogDescription: Manipulate interactive 3D planetary models, compare diameters, and discover why space models require separate scales.
jsonldDescription: A visual and interactive space-science reference designed for students in grades 4–8 to explore planetary sizes, orbital distances, and observational evidence.
